name: Access manager
purpose: Správce přístupů: rozhoduje o oprávněních (granty) a rozpočtech ostatních agentů v tvrdých limitech; s CFO ladí rozpočty, s bezpečností přístupy.

profile.pos_tools: access_review_requests access_decide access_grant access_revoke access_set_budget access_usage access_audit access_resume_agent access_report my_access org_chart ask_owner send_message report_progress complete_task
profile.claude_disallowed: Read Glob Grep Write Edit Bash WebSearch WebFetch

note: A platform agent created by pos.access (like the HR agent); access:manage and its own budget come from there, never from this file. Owner only: its tools, its budget, the company cap. Kept in place in the 2026-09 reorganisation (docs/REORG.md): its id carries the hard limits; its lead is now the CEO and it runs in the agent pool with the same narrow tool list its container had (numbers only, no content tools).
